title: USF-175 file scanner provider disposition matrix

humanDecision.decisionSummary: File scanner provider parity is split by semantic requirement. Deterministic in-memory scan markers are accepted only where service catalogue authority permits them and are not equivalent to ClamAV composed provider semantics.
humanDecision.implementationStatus: USF-200 profile-gated composed-service proof present; quarantine release workflow, DLP readiness, signature database freshness readiness, live provider operation, and API/worker runtime binding remain outside this issue.

scannerProviderDisposition.riskStatement: ClamAV profile-gated composed proof could be overclaimed as scanner readiness, live malware scanning, DLP, vulnerability clearance, API/worker runtime binding, environment readiness, or USF-133 closure.
scannerProviderDisposition.treatment: USF-200 proves bounded SDK-backed local Compose ClamAV service semantics with explicit non-claims for release workflow, signature freshness, DLP, live provider operation, API/worker runtime use, and environment readiness.
scannerProviderDisposition.deferredEvidence: Quarantine release workflow, signature database freshness readiness, DLP readiness, live scanner provider readiness, production data handling, and environment promotion evidence remain deferred and unclaimed.

deterministicScanSubstituteBoundary.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: Deterministic in-memory scan markers and files capability proof are not equivalent to ClamAV composed provider scan invocation, signature database posture, clean/infected wire response semantics, provider unavailable handling, timeout, readiness retry, release workflow, retention, deletion, audit operation evidence, supplier posture, or teardown behaviour.
scopeCovered: tenant-safe hermetic file scan status and quarantine proof where semantically permitted
files capability proof posture from USF-147/USF-146 lineage
value-free repository evidence and validation linkage
limits: does not prove ClamAV adapter binding
does not prove ClamAV clean or infected scan response compatibility
does not prove ClamAV signature database freshness or update posture
does not prove provider unavailable, timeout, readiness retry, or failure-mode behaviour
does not prove composed scanner quarantine release, deletion, retention, or teardown
does not prove live scanner, DLP, vulnerability-clearance, test, staging, production, SOC, ISO, full dev, or full product readiness

providerBoundary.providerRegistryEvidence: packages/core/src/index.ts records file-scan-clamav-composed-test as a local composed proof-only provider; file-scan-clamav-deferred remains for live/external scanner non-claims.

semanticProofBoundaries.nonEquivalenceBoundary: Deterministic marker proof remains non-equivalent; ClamAV clean and infected outcomes are proven only in profile-gated local Compose for synthetic payloads.
USF-200 proves provider-unavailable fail-closed quarantine routing, quarantined download denial, clean-file deletion, value-free audit evidence, and Compose teardown for synthetic data only.

USF-200 does not prove privileged quarantine release workflow, signature database freshness readiness, DLP readiness, live scanner provider readiness, production vulnerability clearance, or environment promotion.

USF-200 records clamscan 2.4.0 as a de-facto TCP ClamAV client inside the adapter boundary for local Compose proof only; live supplier, production incident, privacy, and retention posture remain non-claims.

operationalEvidencePosture.failClosed: provider-unavailable scan result quarantines and quarantined download is denied
operationalEvidencePosture.structuredLogging: value-free proof output only; no provider payloads
operationalEvidencePosture.tracingCorrelation: trace and correlation hash evidence captured
operationalEvidencePosture.metrics: readiness attempts retry count failure count latency bucket fail-closed denial and health status captured
operationalEvidencePosture.auditEvents: value-free file quarantine audit evidence captured
operationalEvidencePosture.redaction: raw endpoints credentials SDK errors stack traces provider payloads EICAR payload and object bodies are not emitted

sdkClientSelection.selectionRationale: ClamAV exposes clamd TCP semantics rather than an official first-party TypeScript SDK. clamscan 2.4.0 is a maintained de-facto Node client that supports clamd TCP usage with local binary fallback disabled; raw sockets, shelling out, curl, ad hoc TCP, clamdjs, and direct local binary invocation were rejected for this bounded proof.
sdkClientSelection.licencePosture: MIT package metadata reviewed for local proof; licence posture must be re-reviewed before stronger readiness or live-provider claims.
sdkClientSelection.maintenancePosture: Exact pinned package version 2.4.0; update/deprecation owner must review releases before changes.
sdkClientSelection.securityAdvisoryPosture: Dependency advisory review is required before version changes and before stronger readiness claims; no external egress or real credentials are used by the local proof.
sdkClientSelection.typescriptRuntimeCompatibility: Repository supplies a local TypeScript module declaration for the adapter boundary; SDK import remains inside adapters/store only.
sdkClientSelection.localComposeCompatibility: Configured for clamd TCP on loopback-published ephemeral port with localFallback disabled and no local binary invocation.
alternativesRejected: shelling out to clamdscan or clamscan
curl or ad hoc protocol calls
clamdjs due older maintenance posture and weaker TypeScript posture for this repo
local binary fallback because the proof must bind to composed service semantics
